basics.name: Ada Lovelace
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: Software engineer with 8+ years building reliable, well-tested web platforms. Comfortable across the stack, from API design to accessible front-ends, with a track record of shipping products that scale.

work.name: Analytical Engines Ltd.
work.summary: Lead engineer on the data platform team.
highlights: Designed and shipped a streaming ingestion pipeline handling 2M events/minute with 99.99% uptime.
Mentored four engineers and introduced a code-review checklist that cut production incidents by 30%.
Reduced cloud spend by 22% by right-sizing services and adding autoscaling.

work.name: Difference Co.
work.summary: Full-stack engineer on the customer-facing web app.
highlights: Rebuilt the checkout flow, increasing conversion by 12%.
Added end-to-end test coverage, reducing regressions in release candidates.

projects.name: Open Notebook
projects.description: An open-source, collaborative notebook for reproducible data analysis.
highlights: 3k+ GitHub stars and an active contributor community.
Featured in a popular data-science newsletter.

awards.title: Engineering Excellence Award
awards.summary: Recognised for leadership on the data platform migration.

references.name: Charles Babbage, CTO at Analytical Engines Ltd.
